row: Hi, I’m Shawn Brock, owner of FixingPain Clinic in Pleasanton, CA. I teach pain relief, muscle release, sports massage, and mobility techniques to help fix tight muscles, improve movement, and reduce injury. Whether you’re a massage therapist, athlete, or just want to feel better, you’ll learn simple, effective hands-on methods that actually work. My SB Method focuses on real results for pain, performance, and recovery.
